finding.description: QueueTargetedPhysicsWakeRequest treated a negative corrupted queue counter as an unsigned overflow and wrote counter.Value=capacity. The next FlushPhysicsTargetWakeRequests could then process stale wake mirror slots as if the queue were full.
finding.affectedRoute: targeted Rigidbody wake requests copied from PhysicsCullingTargetWakeRequestSignal into Shinobu physics culling wake mirror
finding.runtimeImpact: Rare corrupt-counter path could replay stale targeted wake DTOs and wake/restore unrelated culling state in the owner slow-tick sync phase.

fix.queueWrite: capacity <= 0 or writeIndex < 0 now fails closed, sets Flags |= 1, resets counter.Value to 0, and increments lock/contention telemetry without writing a mirror slot.
fix.queueFlush: FlushPhysicsTargetWakeRequests now computes non-negative queueCapacity and clamps counter.Value to [0, queueCapacity] before copying scratch DTOs.
fix.allocationPolicy: No new managed allocation. Existing fixed PhysicsCullingTargetWakeRequestSignal[64] scratch remains the only apply scratch.

buildGate.policy: AGENTS.md forbids dotnet build while CPU > 50% or compiler/dotnet processes are active.
